name: SSHI_FBR_Zener
rationale: The reference FBR fails S2 and S4 due to the diode voltage drop (approx 0.5V) being too significant when the piezo's open-circuit voltage is low (especially in S4 where Voc_peak is ~1.9V). Synchronous Switch Harvesting on Inductor (SSHI) is implemented by adding an inductor and a switch across the piezo to flip the voltage at its extrema, effectively boosting the voltage available to the rectifier. A Zener diode (DZ33) is added to the output to clamp the voltage to 3.3V, preventing the overvoltage failure seen in S3. A storage capacitor is used to minimize ripple and stabilize the mean output for S5.
